mechanism.claim: The correlation between completed five-minute BTC returns and log quote volume over a day measures whether positive or negative moves receive greater participation. An extreme signed correlation in a high-variation state identifies volume-sponsored price discovery that continues for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed return-log-volume Pearson correlation
mechanism.why_distinct: VSPCR discretized bars into top/bottom volume quartiles and required opposing cohort returns at four-hour onsets; HDVBR used one dominant bar; close-VWAP candidates used price displacement. HVVRCR uses the continuous full-day return-volume covariance at one daily clock, reuses no event set, and promotes no control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed 24-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one sparse daily 02:05 UTC continuous covariance clock is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.window: 288 exact contiguous completed BTCUSDT five-minute bars [decision-24h,decision)
features.bar_return: log(close/open) on each coherent positive-OHLC bar
features.volume_return_correlation: sample Pearson correlation across 288 bar-return and log-volume pairs; both sample stds positive; strict nonzero
features.absolute_correlation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid daily observations, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.70
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 90 valid days, minimum 60, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.decision: daily 02:00 UTC after all source bars complete
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: continuous volume-sponsorship transmission in volatile BTC

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no covariance formula, rank, side, clock, hold, subset, or control repair
